beats.say: In a lecture at Johns Hopkins in October 2026, Tim O'Reilly traces Silicon Valley's move from customer-centered innovation to extraction driven by shareholder capitalism.
He started his company more than 40 years ago with a 500-dollar investment, and launched the first web portal in 1993.
Now, he argues, monopoly ambitions and hype shape the AI boom — a far cry from the valley's early days.
